evidence.quote: AWS Organizations now supports up to 2,000 resource control policies (RCPs) per organization, doubling the previous limit of 1,000.
No action is required — existing organizations automatically have access to the higher limit.

evidence.heading: AWS Organizations increases RCP quota to 2,000 per organization
